originalTitle: Germany’s far-right AfD thanks Elon Musk as France warns state election win a ‘serious moment’
summary: Lead candidate in Saxony-Anhalt welcomes further ‘strong’ cooperation with Musk as French minister says ‘We cannot forget our history’
content: The candidate who led the far-right Alternative für Deutschland party to a historic state election victory in Germany has thanked Elon Musk for his support, as one French minister warned that this was a “serious moment” for Europe. The AfD more than doubled its support in the Saxony-Anhalt region and appears to be on the brink of becoming the first far-right party to gain power in Germany at state level since the second world war. On Sunday night, Ulrich Siegmund, the AfD’s lead candidate, thanked Musk on X “for your support and for your clear and highly important perspective on the political developments of our time”, adding: “I would very much welcome the opportunity for strong and constructive cooperation”. Siegmund wrote his comments after Musk said “Well done!” in German to AfD co-founder Alice Weidel, when she posted about the projected win. Earlier, US president Donald Trump posted a screenshot of the election projection without comment on his Truth Social site. Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev took a screengrab of Trump’s post and praised a “historic win for the pragmatic AfD”. AfD is pro-Kremlin, urging a stop to support for Ukraine and pushing for Ukrainians to no longer receive refugee status. Exit polls showed the party to have secured 44.4% of the vote, a larger share than predicted, and decisively larger than that of the Christian Democrats (CDU) of the chancellor, Friedrich Merz, in a contest that was being followed across the world. However, it still remains unclear as to how and whether the AfD will be able to form a government, having ruled out entering a coalition and being refused any form of cooperation by the mainstream parties. The CDU was trailing massively on around 18.4% and the far-left Die Linke was third with 9.3%, with the Social Democrats on 8.4% and the Greens on 8.7% by around early evening. France’s Europe minister, Benjamin Haddad, described the win as “a serious moment in Europe”, warning that “nationalism and xenophobia will never be a solution”. “We must listen with humility to the anger, the concerns, the fears, and respond to them,” he added. “We cannot forget our history. That is the meaning behind the choices made by France and Germany.” Donald Tusk, the prime minister of Poland, said: “In Poland, only idiots or traitors can rejoice at the triumph of the AfD in Germany.” The German Economic Institute has warned of the far-reaching consequences for the German economy, in Saxony-Anhalt and beyond. It said the AfD’s immigration policy would be “calamitous” for the state, which has an ageing, dwindling population and is heavily dependent on foreign workers. Critics have also warned that an AfD-run state, due to the Kremlin-friendly stance of the party, could leak sensitive information to Russia. The AfD has dismissed such claims. It has said it would seek to reform the domestic intelligence service, calling it biased.
chineseTitle: 德国极右翼选择党感谢埃隆·马斯克，法国警告州选举胜利是“重要时刻”
chineseSummary: 萨克森-安哈特州的首席候选人欢迎与马斯克进一步“强有力”的合作，法国部长表示“我们不能忘记我们的历史”
chineseContent: 领导极右翼德国选择党在德国取得历史性州选举胜利的候选人感谢埃隆·马斯克的支持，一位法国部长警告说，这对欧洲来说是一个“严肃的时刻”。德国选择党在萨克森-安哈尔特地区的支持率增加了一倍多，似乎即将成为二战以来第一个在德国州一级获得权力的极右翼政党。周日晚上，选择党的主要候选人乌尔里希·西格蒙德在 X 上感谢马斯克“对我们时代政治发展的支持以及对我们时代政治发展的清晰且非常重要的观点”，并补充道：“我非常欢迎有机会进行强有力和建设性的合作”。西格蒙德在马斯克说“干得好！”后发表了他的评论。当她发布有关预计获胜的消息时，她用德语向 AfD 联合创始人 Alice Weidel 说道。早些时候，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在他的真相社交网站上发布了一张选举预测的屏幕截图，但没有发表评论。俄罗斯总统特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫截取了特朗普帖子的屏幕截图，并称赞“务实的德国选择党取得了历史性胜利”。另类选择党支持克里姆林宫，敦促停止支持乌克兰，并推动乌克兰人不再获得难民身份。出口民意调查显示，该党获得了 44.4% 的选票，比例高于预期，并且明显高于德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨 (Friedrich Merz) 领导的基民盟 (CDU)，这场竞选受到了全世界的关注。然而，由于排除了加入联合政府的可能性，并且主流政党拒绝任何形式的合作，目前还不清楚选择党如何以及是否能够组建政府。基民盟以 18.4% 左右的得票率大幅落后，极左翼党以 9.3% 的得票率排名第三，社会党
